批量重命名.title: 批量重命名
批量重命名.text:
import os

path = r'd:\Pictures\QQplayerPic'
label = 'E5'
for index, file in enumerate(os.listdir(path)):
 os.rename(os.path.join(path,file),os.path.join(path,label + '.' + str(index + 1))+".png")
